component.name: The Man Who Counted
component.summary: Solve the riddles of Beremiz Samir

description.p: A visual novel inspired by Malba Tahan's book “The Man Who Counted” (O Homem que Calculava). The story is narrated, and as it unfolds you stand in the sandals of Beremiz Samir, the man who counted. When Beremiz meets a riddle, so do you — and solving it carries the story forward.
This is a pre-alpha build: an early, incomplete look at the game. It contains:

ul.li: A narrated prologue on the road to Baghdad, with painted, cross-fading scenes
The trial of the eight gold balls: find the one heavier ball with a balance, in two weighings

description.p: Pre-alpha build 1: the prologue and the balance puzzle as a native GNOME app.
